Protein Food

Whole Rabbit

About This Entry

Whole rabbit is roasted or braised — classic French and Italian farmhouse protein. Mild, lean meat pairs with Pinot Noir, Chianti, and rustic whites with herbal notes.

Beginner Guide

One rabbit feeds two generously. Joint into pieces for even cooking or braise whole with wine.

FAQ

What is Whole Rabbit?
One rabbit feeds two generously.
How should Whole Rabbit be cooked for best results?
Lean game benefits from careful doneness — avoid overcooking loins; braise tougher cuts. Rest before slicing.
